description:
EPA Superfund sites near a US street address (50 states and DC), free. `address` = full street address with
        house number, city and state.

        Returns the National Priorities List (NPL) sites within 3 miles (name, EPA id, status: final / proposed /
        deleted, listing and deletion dates, distance in miles and direction, EPA site page), how many active NPL sites
        are within 1 and 3 miles, the number of other Superfund (SEMS) sites within 1 mile and of EPA-regulated
        facilities within 0.5 mile, all measured from the address's geocoded point.

        status 'invalid' = the address could not be matched (the message says why); 'unavailable' = EPA or the Census
        geocoder did not answer (NOT a 'no sites' answer, retry later). Tell the user it is a records lookup, not a
        Phase I Environmental Site Assessment. The full search (RCRA, tanks, brownfields, flood, wetlands, radon, map)
        is the Environmental Records Report: order_title_search(address, report_type='environmental').
name: superfund_sites_near_address
